definitions.gloss: combined use, using together, using in conjunction
definitions.explanation: Using two or more things at the same time or in combination. Common in medical contexts (combining treatments) and general descriptions of using multiple methods.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{他|ほか}の{薬|くすり}と{併用|へいよう}できる。
examples.english: This medicine can be used in combination with other medicines.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}と{薬物療法|やくぶつりょうほう}を{併用|へいよう}する。
examples.english: Surgery and drug therapy are used in combination.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}とアプリを{併用|へいよう}して{効率|こうりつ}よく{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I study efficiently by using both a dictionary and an app together.

notes:
Composed of {併|へい} (together, parallel) and {用|よう} (use). Frequently encountered in medical and pharmaceutical contexts where it refers to combining treatments or medications. The pattern AとBを{併用|へいよう}する means "to use A and B together."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬|くすり}を{併用|へいよう}する (use medicines in combination)
- {併用|へいよう}{禁忌|きんき} (contraindicated combination)
- {併用|へいよう}{療法|りょうほう} (combination therapy)
- 〜と{併用|へいよう}する (use in combination with ~)
